title: Application to qualified foreign corporations.
bodyText: A foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this State on July 1, 2001 is subject to this chapter but is not required to obtain a new certificate of authority to transact business under this chapter.

annotations.heading: Revision Note

bodyHtml:
[§414-482]  Application to qualified foreign corporations.  A foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this State on July 1, 2001 is subject to this chapter but is not required to obtain a new certificate of authority to transact business under this chapter. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 2001" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter".
